reserveReview.rationale: Backed identifies bC3M as a tracker certificate whose sole underlying is the Amundi C3M UCITS ETF, which tracks 0-6 month Eurozone government bills. The live chainlink-por adapter emits the source's exact assetLabel "AMUNDI GOVIES 0-6 Months Euro Investment Grade ETF shares"; the reviewed sidecar preserves that identity and classifies it as one fund-share position with Amundi as issuer/obligor. Backed's public assetReserves feed reported the C3M.MI reserve and total bC3M circulation with Chainlink as provider on July 21, 2026; Backed states that The Network Firm reads custody-account balances and Chainlink publishes the proof daily or after a material deviation. The reserve is recorded as one fund-share position without estimating the ETF's changing sovereign holdings. September 15, 2026 review independently reproduced distributed circulation by subtracting the two issuer-documented working-capital and treasury inventories from same-block gross supply. All eight issuer-documented EVM deployments were checked, including zero-supply Fantom. Current raw amounts match the issuer API on every reported chain; omitted BSC and Fantom deployments independently have zero gross and circulating supply. This establishes a current distributed-certificate denominator without treating the undated API or gross premint inventory as current liabilities. The reserve oracle retains its own observation clock; no fund look-through or legal segregation is inferred. Classification-only review 2026-10-20: the preceding current/zero statements describe the September 15 observation, not a new supply pin. July 21 composition and all September authority/supply pins are preserved. The exact underlying ISIN FR0010754200 is independently joined by the current Backed product page to the Amundi Prospectus and Reglement updated April 16, 2026. Prospectus redemption provisions permit gates for up to 20 NAV dates over three months; Reglement Article 3 permits exceptional payment extension to 30 days and temporary suspension. The reserve liquidity horizon is therefore conservatively over-seven-days, not an immediate or seven-day whole-position liquidation promise. This establishes an adverse contractual liquidity category without inventing executable capacity, a stressed realization guarantee, current holdings or a finite fund-share maturity. October 27, 2026 renewal: the Polygon Chainlink feed 0x648e0ff6a36d58f6fce5927cb77601b73cadc2af (latestRoundData updatedAt 2026-10-26T15:49:41Z, answer 0.7 C3M.MI shares at 8 decimals) still reports the single C3M.MI fund-share reserve, and Backed's API Ethereum circulatingSupply of 0.7000000000023 bC3M agrees with it; the composition remains one fund-share position at 100% and the July 21 amounts are superseded by this wind-down read, so compositionAsOf and the report period move to October 26.
